raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: txaio
  version: "26.6.1"
  python_min: "3.11"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3ee900b2331c93457530fddbccc1a320c4e2d7ac8f9073d01c3fbe87762ccb35

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-build-isolation --no-deps

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - hatchling
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
  run_constraints:
    - zope.interface >=5.2.0
    - twisted >=22.10.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - txaio
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Compatibility API between asyncio/Twisted/Trollius
  homepage: https://github.com/crossbario/txaio
  repository: https://github.com/crossbario/txaio
  documentation: http://txaio.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - synapticarbors
